packageRules.description: Base image 'ubuntu': stay on the 24.04 LTS tag but pin it by digest, and let Renovate keep that digest current (tracks the latest 24.04 rebuild for reproducible-yet-updated builds).
Disable GitHub Actions updates. Temporarily, not possible with GITHUB_TOKEN only.
Block any major version updates. Remove or empty array to allow major updates.

Base image 'ubuntu': block tag version changes so it never moves off 24.04 to a non-LTS (24.10) or the next LTS (26.04) - only digest updates are allowed. Bump the tag by hand when adopting the next LTS.

Regex filter for used LTS. PowerShell is pinned to the current LTS minor line 7.6.x -> patch updates only. PowerShell uses EVEN minors for LTS (7.4, 7.6, ...) and ODD minors for STS (7.5, 7.7, ...); this allowedVersions blocks any move off 7.6, so no STS like 7.5.x/7.7.x. Bump this range by hand when adopting the next LTS (e.g. 7.8).

ORAS: patch updates only. Block minor and major bumps so it stays on the current minor line (e.g. 1.3.x); bump the ARG by hand when adopting a new minor. Uses matchUpdateTypes rather than an allowedVersions regex because ORAS has no LTS/minor-parity constraint, so this needs no editing when the minor is bumped manually - patch updates resume automatically on the new line.

postUpgradeTasks.description: After a version bump, refresh the matching ARG *_CHECKSUM in the Dockerfiles so the version and its checksum land in the same PR (build stays offline, no live checksum fetch). Self-hosted only: the command must be allowlisted via allowedCommands (RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS in .github/workflows/renovate.yml).

customManagers.description: DOCKERFILE-ARG packages: track versions pinned via 'ARG <NAME>_VERSION' with a 'renovate:' comment above them
IMAGES: update cr.vidinet.net image tags annotated with a 'renovate:' comment above the 'tag:' line
